title: Generative Responsible AI Data Evaluation Schema (GRAIDES) for AI Assurance in Local Government

notes: GPT-4.1-nano is pinned to a still-callable id and genuinely run as a classifier (not just a judge), but its own accuracy/F1 numbers appear only inside Figure 6's chart, never as printed text; only GPT-4o-mini's headline number (86.5% accuracy) is quoted in prose.
